//: Functions run next to the database. Supabase is in eu-west-2 (London) and Vercel's unset default is iad1 (Washington DC), so every logged-in page was crossing SA -> Virginia -> London and back for each of the several sequential DAL queries a page makes. lhr1 co-locates the functions with Postgres: the DB round trips collapse to single-digit ms and South African users lose a transatlantic hop. Move this if the database ever moves.
